headline: Commission approves minutes, hears evaluation, union and budget updates

meeting.summary: The commission approved its November 6, 2024 minutes and heard updates on the director's review, union contract talks and the budget.
meeting.recap: Vice Chair Sharon Suzuki and Commissioner Wallace Tom confirmed they were attending from home.[[0:00:47]] No one gave public testimony.[[0:01:08]] The commission approved the minutes of its November 6, 2024 meeting by a unanimous voice vote.[[0:01:27]] The commission still plans to return to in-person meetings in April 2025.[[0:02:08]] Questions for the yearly review of the personnel services director are being written.[[0:02:20]] The review was described as due at the end of the first quarter of the calendar year, in March.[[0:03:02]] The director said the county's switch to Microsoft 365 went fairly smoothly, with some bugs still being fixed.[[0:04:16]] In collective bargaining (union contract talks), staff will meet a union for the first time on December 16th.[[0:05:13]] The department is working on firefighters' requests for financial information.[[0:06:01]] The department asked for a list of arbitrators for another union and has not received it yet.[[0:06:10]] The department was asked to prepare a flat budget and so far is under it.[[0:06:42]] The director said the mayor sends the budget to the County Council at the end of March.[[0:06:59]] The next meeting is set for January 8.[[0:07:47]] The meeting was adjourned by a unanimous voice vote.[[0:08:26]]
decided: The commission approved the November 6, 2024 minutes as presented by a unanimous voice vote.
The commission voted unanimously to adjourn.
meeting.next: The review questions will go to staff to share with department directors and Personnel Services employees. The director will share the department's budget request with the commission once it is final. The department expects to hear back from the budget office in early January.

moments.q: "we're still targeting uh to resume inperson meetings in April of 2025"
